Needed so monitoring restarts after a reboot or update. Tap and turn on Autostart for SwitchGuard.
Samsung may put the app to sleep. In Battery, choose \"Unrestricted\" and add SwitchGuard to \"Never sleeping apps\" (Battery → Background usage limits).
In App launch, set SwitchGuard to \"Manage manually\" and turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
Turn on Auto launch for SwitchGuard, then in its Battery settings allow background activity.
Allow SwitchGuard to start in the background and allow high background power consumption.

Choose the app you use to control your devices today.
Devices you control in the Smart Life or Tuya Smart app
Have both? Set up one now and add the other later in Settings.
Create a free Tuya Cloud project
SwitchGuard reads your devices through Tuya\'s official cloud API with your own free project. It takes about five minutes.
On platform.tuya.com create a free account, then Cloud → Create Cloud Project: Development method "Smart Home", data center = your Smart Life account region (Europe / Türkiye: Central Europe).
In the project: Devices → Link App Account → Add App Account, and scan the QR code with the Smart Life / Tuya app.

Message Service tab: enable it (AES-GCM). Messaging Rules → Production Environment → Create: pick devicePropertyMessage, deviceOnline and deviceOffline, tap Release Rule — then switch the rule ON. Without this, changes arrive only every few minutes.
Copy the Access ID and Access Secret from the project\'s Overview page into the next step.

The free Tuya Cloud trial must be extended now and then (Cloud → IoT Core → Extend trial period); SwitchGuard warns you when it expires. Devices that were only shared with you may not appear — ask the owner to add you as a home member.
Enter the Access ID and Access Secret. SwitchGuard checks them and shows how many devices it found.
Star = keep at the top · arrows = move · card size = small or large · tag = category. Long-press a card to come back here.
No categories yet. Create one, e.g. "Manholes" or "Lighting".
No devices in this category yet — assign them with the tag button.
These keys are stored only on this phone and are sent nowhere except Tuya\'s own servers.
Enter the Access ID and Access Secret of your Tuya Cloud project (platform.tuya.com → Cloud → your project → Overview). Your Smart Life / Tuya app account must be linked to the project.
A device shared with you is missing? Tuya only lists the devices in your homes. Ask the owner to add you as a home member in Smart Life (Me → Home Management → Add Member).
Tuya connected, but no devices were found. Check that your Smart Life / Tuya app account is linked to the project in the same data center.
Tuya rejected the Access ID / Secret, or the data center is wrong.
Tuya Cloud trial has expired, so Tuya devices are not being monitored. Extend it at platform.tuya.com → Cloud → IoT Core → Extend trial period.
Tuya message service refused the connection (is Message Service enabled with an active rule?)
Choose the language of the app, notifications and alarms.
Monitoring will stop. Your settings and history are kept.
Keeps the processor awake so no event is ever delayed. Uses more battery.
Wait this long before alerting that a device went offline. If it comes back in time, no alert is raised.

The phone stopped SwitchGuard in the background and it couldn\'t restart. Tap to resume; to prevent this, allow unrestricted background activity.
Check the internet connection and Settings › Permissions (battery).
Warns when SwitchGuard can\'t watch your devices
No internet or no cloud connection for this long: you get a warning
Used only when instant updates aren\'t available.

After you dismiss an alarm, it rings again at this interval while the device stays in the state that caused it (still off, still on or offline). Stops when the device is back to normal.
Try the alarm now: with sound or silently, right away or after 10 seconds
Rings and vibrates like a real alarm

Restricted — alarms may be delayed. Tap to fix.

The “Alarms” notification category isn\'t set to high priority, so the alarm won\'t pop up or fill the screen.
In this mode even alarm sounds are muted.
The phone\'s alarm volume is at or near zero, so you may not hear SwitchGuard. Fix turns on “Ring at full volume”.
The phone may put monitoring to sleep; alarms can be late or missed.
With the phone locked, the alarm can\'t open its large screen.
With the phone locked, the alarm screen can\'t open. Tap Fix, open Other permissions and turn on “Show on Lock screen” and “Open new windows while running in the background”.
This is a second copy of SwitchGuard

This copy was made with the phone\'s Dual apps (app clone) feature. Two copies running side by side ring every alarm twice and sign each other out when they use the same eWeLink account; on Xiaomi phones the other copy\'s permissions also appear switched off. Use one copy: tap Remove and uninstall this copy on the page that opens.
There\'s a second SwitchGuard on this phone

Another copy of SwitchGuard was made with the phone\'s Dual apps (app clone) feature. Two copies running side by side ring every alarm twice and sign each other out when they use the same eWeLink account; on Xiaomi phones this copy\'s permissions can also appear switched off. Remove the second copy: touch and hold its icon (the one with the small badge) and tap Uninstall.

SwitchGuard talks to your devices through eWeLink\'s official API. You need your own free App ID for this — it takes about two minutes.
Open dev.ewelink.cc and sign in with the eWeLink account your devices are in.

If your account isn\'t a developer yet (new accounts): My center → Account Settings → “Not a developer yet? Apply now!” → Individual developers → submit the form. eWeLink has to approve it; continue after approval (the free standard role is enough).
Create an app and set its Redirect URL to %s
Copy the App ID and App Secret you are given.

Paste the App ID and App Secret from your developer app.

Tip: eWeLink allows one session per account. Give each phone its own eWeLink account and share the devices from the eWeLink app.
Automations run on this phone while monitoring is on. For schedules that must work even when the phone is off, use the timers on the device page.

Examples:
• When the sump level channel turns on, turn on the lights
• If the pump stays on for 30 minutes, turn it off and ring the alarm
• If power goes above 2000 W, notify me

Virtual devices for trying every feature

These act as if something happened at the device itself (someone switched it, the power or Wi-Fi went out), so your rules apply and the alarm can ring. Switching with the buttons above counts as you and does not ring the alarm.
Needed on Android TV so the alarm appears on top of whatever is playing. Tap and allow SwitchGuard.
Tip: type or paste from your phone with the Google TV app (remote → keyboard).
Up and down change the value. OK on the hour moves to minutes, OK on the minutes saves, Back cancels.
Already set up on your phone? Get Tuya keys, rules and settings over your home Wi-Fi. For eWeLink this device needs its own account and that account\'s own API keys.
Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
On your phone open SwitchGuard → Settings → Backup & transfer → Send to another device, pick this device and enter the code below.
Setup received: Tuya keys, rules and settings are here. If you use eWeLink, now enter the API keys of the account you created for this device.
Each device needs its own eWeLink account

Your other device is signed in as %1$s: don\'t sign in with that account here — eWeLink allows one session per account and it would be signed out. For this device: create a new account in the eWeLink app, share your devices with it (device → Share), apply as a developer with that account on dev.ewelink.cc and wait for eWeLink\'s approval, then enter that account\'s API keys (App ID / App Secret) here. The API keys entered here must belong to the account signed in here.
This device is signed in as %1$s, the same account as your phone, so your phone\'s eWeLink session has probably been closed. Sign in here with a separate account that your devices are shared with.
Copy Tuya keys, rules and settings to a TV or tablet on the same Wi-Fi
Get the setup from your phone over Wi-Fi
On the TV or tablet open SwitchGuard → Transfer from another device. It appears here when it\'s on the same Wi-Fi.
Wrong code. Check the code on the other device.
Couldn\'t reach the device. Make sure both are on the same Wi-Fi.
eWeLink API keys and session were not transferred: on the other device enter the API keys of the account you created for it and sign in.

Don\'t sign in on this device with the eWeLink account used on your other device (e.g. your phone) — eWeLink allows one session per account and the other device is signed out. For this device: create a new account in the eWeLink app, share your devices with it (device → Share), apply as a developer with that account on dev.ewelink.cc and wait for eWeLink\'s approval, then enter that account\'s API keys (App ID / App Secret) here. The API keys entered here must belong to the account signed in here.
Easiest on a TV: choose “Login by QR code” at the bottom of the sign-in page and scan it with the eWeLink app signed in to the account you created for this device.

The TV or tablet needs its own eWeLink account: create a new account in the eWeLink app, share your devices with it, apply as a developer with that account and wait for eWeLink\'s approval, then enter that account\'s API keys on the other device. eWeLink keys are not transferred; Tuya keys, rules and settings are. Signing in there with this phone\'s account signs this phone out.
